name: Micron

header.one_liner: Memory at the top of a violent cycle: record earnings, a single-digit multiple, and a stance that is mostly a bet on whether this is the peak.
header.thesis: Revenue went from $37.4B to $133.2B in one fiscal year with 81% GAAP gross margin. A 12.6x multiple on peak earnings is how the market prices a cycle. The engine's wide scenario spread is the honest answer.

rev_cagr.why: FQ1-27 revenue is guided to $61.5B (about $246B annualised) but memory pricing is cyclical. The base case assumes three-year growth well below the current run-rate because supply responds.

margin_end.why: Net margin today is 65% (non-GAAP net income $86.76B on $133.19B). Gross margin was -9.1% in FY2023, so the base case assumes substantial mean reversion.
margin_end.source: Micron FQ4 2026 release; prior-cycle history from the existing card

share_chg.why: FY2026 repurchases were only $0.65B against a $1.08T market cap, so share count barely moves.

exit_pe.why: Memory trades at single-digit multiples at peak earnings because the market expects mean reversion.

pillars.title: Earnings at an unprecedented level
pillars.claim: FQ4 revenue $54.2B and non-GAAP EPS $33.42 against $11.3B revenue a year earlier. FQ1-27 guide EPS $38.15.
pillars.test: Does FQ1-27 land inside the $61.5B plus or minus $1.5B guide?

pillars.title: The multiple prices a peak
pillars.claim: At about 12.6x FY26 EPS the stock is cheap if earnings persist and expensive if margins revert to cycle averages.

evidence.t: Gross margin was -9.1% in FY2023 (existing card, FY2025 10-K)

pillars.test: Does gross margin hold above 80% for another two quarters?

variant.ours: The engine is deliberately wide: the value is in the spread of outcomes, not the point estimate.
variant.could_be_wrong: If AI memory demand is structurally under-supplied, margins stay high.
variant.would_change_mind: Contract price declines for two consecutive quarters.

moat.summary: Three-player DRAM oligopoly with huge capital barriers, but price is set by the cycle, not the firm.

quality.leverage_note: Debt $5.18B against cash and investments of $73.5B: net cash.

tripwires.note: FQ1-27 guide is $61.5B plus or minus $1.5B, above the $60B line.

risks: Capacity additions across the three suppliers.
Export controls and China exposure (not covered here).

sources.title: Micron Technology Form 8-K, fiscal Q4 2026 press release
Financial Modeling Prep: company profile, treasury rates, market risk premium

gaps: DRAM, NAND and HBM revenue split not in the release.
